subject: Offsite planning — venue options
body_html:
Hi,

Here are the three venue options for the Q4 team offsite (November 14-15):
1. Lakeside Conference Centre — $180/person, capacity 40
2. Downtown Cowork Hub — $120/person, capacity 25
3. Acme Campus (free) — limited AV

Please vote on your preference by Friday.

Noah
